items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: So I have fond memories — this is the Steve Allen days if I’m not — I mean it’s either Steven Allen or pre-Steve Allen.

ctx.x: Yeah, they had a heck of a band.

So I have fond memories — this is the Steve Allen days if I’m not — I mean it’s either Steven Allen or pre-Steve Allen. I think it’s Steve Allen. And — definitely it was Steve Allen. And Ross Russell left behind a stack of yellow labeled Dial 78s for me which got mixed in with the Golden records and my Lester Young 78 and the ones that I — and so I have fond recollections. It’s sometimes hard for me on the air to point out that he’s guilty of many outright fictions when he clearly could have known better in…
Yes. Well as a teenager, you had this —
